name: a document is indexed
description: The body is a PhabricatorSearchAbstractDocument as PHP serialises it: camelCase envelope keys, and inside fields and relationships the four-character names that become the literal index keys. Rename any of titl/body/cmnt/auth/ownr/proj here and the write still succeeds — the document simply stops matching the queries that look for it. The reply echoes the PHID so a caller pipelining writes can tell which document was acknowledged.
